71508-the-coat-without-a-seam-and-other-.title: _And Other Poems_
71508-the-coat-without-a-seam-and-other-.creator: Helen Gray Cone
71508-the-coat-without-a-seam-and-other-.description: A book by Helen Gray Cone. There was a web, ere Time began,  Woven on the loom of God,  Woven for the need of Man. Through the web two colors ran,  Blue that is the sky of God,  Red that is the blood of Man. The web was woven, the web was one:  The stars sang when the work was done.

arxiv-2012-12296.title: Semi-analytical model for planetary resonances:
arxiv-2012-12296.creator: Tabaré Gallardo ,, Cristián Beaugé, Cristian A. Giuppone
arxiv-2012-12296.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Tabaré Gallardo ,, Cristián Beaugé, Cristian A. Giuppone. In spite of planetary resonances being a common dynamical mechanism acting on planetary systems, no general model exists for describing their properties, particularly for commensurabilities of any order and arbitrary values of the eccentricities and inclinations. The present work presents a semi-analytical model that describes the resonance strength, width, location and stability of fixed points, as well as periods of small-amplitude librations.

arxiv-2110-03712.title: Gaussian Process for Trajectories
arxiv-2110-03712.creator: Kien Nguyen, John Krumm, Cyrus Shahabi
arxiv-2110-03712.description: Abstract The Gaussian process is a powerful and flexible technique for interpolating spatiotemporal data, especially with its ability to capture complex trends and uncertainty from the input signal. This chapter describes Gaussian processes as an interpolation technique for geospatial trajectories.

arxiv-2110-08689.title: Classical-to-Quantum Transfer Learning for Spoken Command Recognition Based on Quantum Neural Networks
arxiv-2110-08689.creator: Jun Qi, Javier Tejedor
arxiv-2110-08689.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jun Qi, Javier Tejedor. This work investigates an extension of transfer learning applied in machine learning algorithms to the emerging hybrid end-to-end quantum neural network (QNN) for spoken command recognition (SCR). Our QNN-based SCR system is composed of classical and quantum components: (1) the classical part mainly relies on a 1D convolutional neural network (CNN) to extract speech features; (2) the quantum part is built upon the variational quantum circuit with a few learnable parameters.

arxiv-2203-10805.title: Study of magnetoelastic interaction in MnF 2 by the acoustoelectric transformation method
arxiv-2203-10805.creator: I. V. Bilych 1 , K. R. Zhekov 1 , T. N. Haidamak 1∗∗ , G. A. Zvyagina 1 , D. V. Fil 2,3 , V. D. Fil 1
arxiv-2203-10805.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by I. V. Bilych 1 , K. R. Zhekov 1 , T. N. Haidamak 1∗∗ , G. A. Zvyagina 1 , D. V. Fil 2,3 , V. D. Fil 1. The mechanisms of magnetoelastic interaction in MnF 2 are studied using the method of acoustoelectric transformation. The temperature dependence of the piezomagnetic coupling coefficient and its anisotropy are determined in the antiferromagnetic phase.

arxiv-2205-11431.title: Connections between commutative rings and some algebras of logic
arxiv-2205-11431.creator: Cristina Flaut, Dana Piciu
arxiv-2205-11431.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Cristina Flaut, Dana Piciu. In this paper using the connections between some subvarieties of residuated lattices, we investigated some properties of the lattice of ideals in commutative and unitary rings. We give new characterizations for commutative rings A A in which I ​ d ​ ( A ) Id(A) is an MV-algebra, a Heyting algebra or a Boolean algebra and we establish connections between these types of rings. We are very interested in the finite case and we present summarizing statistics.

arxiv-2209-04176.title: Modules in which pure submodule is essential in a direct summand
arxiv-2209-04176.creator: Kaushal Gupta, Shiv Kumar, Ashok Ji Gupta
arxiv-2209-04176.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the class of modules have the property that every pure submodule is essential in a direct summand. These modules are termed as pure extending modules which is a proper generalisation of extending modules. Examples and counterexamples are given.

arxiv-2301-05310.title: Optimization of Hybrid Power Plants: When Is a Detailed Electrolyzer Model Necessary?
arxiv-2301-05310.creator: Manuel Tobias Baumhof, Enrica Raheli, Andrea Gloppen Johnsen, and Jalal Kazempour
arxiv-2301-05310.description: Abstract Hybrid power plants comprising renewable power sources and electrolyzers are envisioned to play a key role in accelerating the transition towards decarbonization. It is common in the current literature to use simplified operational models for electrolyzers. It is still an open question whether this is a good practice, and if not, when a more detailed operational model is necessary.

arxiv-2302-00509.title: Exploring Semantic Perturbations on Grover CMSC 473/673: Capstone in Machine Learning
arxiv-2302-00509.creator: Ziqing Ji, Pranav Kulkarni, Marko Neskovic, Kevin Nolan, Yan Xu
arxiv-2302-00509.description: Abstract With news and information being as easy to access as they currently are, it is more important than ever to ensure that people are not mislead by what they read. Recently, the rise of neural fake news (AI-generated fake news) and its demonstrated effectiveness at fooling humans has prompted the development of models to detect it.

arxiv-2312-15900.title: Chain of Generation: Multi-Modal Gesture Synthesis via Cascaded Conditional Control
arxiv-2312-15900.creator: Zunnan Xu, Yachao Zhang, Sicheng Yang, Ronghui Li, Xiu Li
arxiv-2312-15900.description: Abstract This study aims to improve the generation of 3D gestures by utilizing multimodal information from human speech. Previous studies have focused on incorporating additional modalities to enhance the quality of generated gestures. However, these methods perform poorly when certain modalities are missing during inference. To address this problem, we suggest using speech-derived multimodal priors to improve gesture generation.

arxiv-2407-18960.title: Cosmological implications of the minimum viscosity principle
arxiv-2407-18960.creator: P. G. Tello, Sauro Succi
arxiv-2407-18960.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by P. G. Tello, Sauro Succi. It is shown that black holes in a quark gluon plasma (QGP) obeying minimum viscosity bounds, exhibit a Schwarzschild radius in close match with the range of the strong force. For such black holes, an evaporation time of about 10 16 10^{16} secs is estimated, indicating that they would survive by far the quark-gluon plasma era, namely between 10 − 10 10^{-10} and 10 − 6 10^{-6} seconds after the big bang.

arxiv-2409-13321.title: SLaVA-CXR: Small Language and Vision Assistant for Chest X-ray Report Automation
arxiv-2409-13321.creator: Jinge Wu, Yunsoo Kim, Daqian Shi, David Cliffton, Fenglin Liu, Honghan Wu
arxiv-2409-13321.description: Abstract Inspired by the success of large language models (LLMs), there is growing research interest in developing LLMs in the medical domain to assist clinicians. However, for hospitals, using closed-source commercial LLMs involves privacy issues, and developing open-source public LLMs requires large-scale computational resources, which are usually limited, especially in resource-efficient regions and low-income countries.

arxiv-2411-00559.title: Sound Statistical Model Checking for Probabilities and Expected Rewards Thanks: This work was supported by the DFG through the Cluster of Excellence EXC 2050/1 (CeTI, project ID 390696704, as part of Germany’s Excellence Strategy) and the TRR 248 (see perspicuous-computing.science , project ID 38979
arxiv-2411-00559.creator: Carlos E. Budde, Arnd Hartmanns, Tobias Meggendorfer, Maximilian Weininger, Patrick Wienhöft
arxiv-2411-00559.description: Abstract Statistical model checking estimates probabilities and expectations of interest in probabilistic system models by using random simulations. Its results come with statistical guarantees. However, many tools use unsound statistical methods that produce incorrect results more often than they claim.

arxiv-2506-15242.title: RA-NeRF: Robust Neural Radiance Field Reconstruction with Accurate Camera Pose Estimation under Complex Trajectories
arxiv-2506-15242.creator: Qingsong Yan, Qiang Wang, Kaiyong Zhao, Jie Chen, Bo Li, Xiaowen Chu, Fei Deng
arxiv-2506-15242.description: Abstract Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have emerged as powerful tools for 3D reconstruction and SLAM tasks. However, their performance depends heavily on accurate camera pose priors. Existing approaches attempt to address this issue by introducing external constraints but fall short of achieving satisfactory accuracy, particularly when camera trajectories are complex.

arxiv-2507-22429.title: Comparing Normalizing Flows with Kernel Density Estimation in Estimating Risk of Automated Driving Systems Thanks: The research presented in this work has been made possible by the SYNERGIES project. This project is funded by the European Union’s Horizon Europe Research & Innovation Actions under gr
arxiv-2507-22429.creator: 1 st Erwin de Gelder, 2 nd Maren Buermann, 3 rd Olaf Op den Camp
arxiv-2507-22429.description: Abstract The development of safety validation methods is essential for the safe deployment and operation of ADS . One of the goals of safety validation is to prospectively evaluate the risk of \@iaci ADS ADS dealing with real-world traffic. Scenario-based assessment is a widely-used approach, where test cases are derived from real-world driving data.

arxiv-2512-12653.title: Treatment Effects with Correlated Spillovers: Bridging Discrete and Continuous Methods
arxiv-2512-12653.creator: Tatsuru Kikuchi
arxiv-2512-12653.description: Abstract This paper develops a continuous functional framework for treatment effects propagating through geographic space and economic networks. We derive a master equation from three independent economic foundations—heterogeneous agent aggregation, market equilibrium, and cost minimization—establishing that the framework rests on fundamental principles rather than ad hoc specifications.

pmc-10659845.title: Traditional healing in Kisii County, Kenya: a personal narrative
pmc-10659845.creator: Lydia Matoke
pmc-10659845.description: This article describes the author's experiences growing up in a family of traditional healers, an account of early guidance by her grandmother, a severe illness that influenced her to become a healer and the values that are central to her own work as a traditional healer who specialises in treatment of mental health problems.

pmc-12474167.title: Environmental Exposure to Waterborne Pollutants and Colorectal Cancer Risk in Lebanon
pmc-12474167.creator: Magie Tamraz, Najib Al Ghossaini, Sally Temraz, Dirk W Lachenmeier
pmc-12474167.description: Colorectal cancer (CRC) has a complex etiology involving genetic, lifestyle, and environmental factors. This study investigates the association between exposure to water contaminants and the risk of developing CRC in Lebanon. Population Attributable Fraction (PAF) was calculated using exposure prevalence from environmental reports and water quality assessments.

pmc-12518571.title: Mesenchymal stem cell implantation mitigates ionizing radiation-induced vascular damage in the murine aorta
pmc-12518571.creator: Toshio Uchiki, Nobuyuki Hamada, Asuka Fujita, Ki-ichiro Kawano, Seiko Hirota, Makoto Maeda, Ayano Sasaki, Shogo Nagamatsu, Shinji Yoshinaga, Ayumu Nakashima, Yukihito Higashi
pmc-12518571.description: For preparedness for some scenarios such as unintentional accidents or intentional malicious events, it is of critical importance to develop effective medical countermeasures against normal tissue injury from exposure to ionizing radiation. To this end, agents that are effective when administered after radiation exposure need to be developed.

pmc-13313007.title: Associations Between Social Determinants of Health and Adherence to Biologic Therapies in Patients with Severe Asthma: Real-World Evidence from a Large US Claims Analysis

pmc-13313007.description: PurposeThis study describes factors associated with biologic initiation and adherence, and impacts of adherence on exacerbations among US patients with severe asthma.Patients and MethodsThis retrospective cohort study defined two populations, biologic-eligible patients and biologic users, using the Komodo Research Database of healthcare claims (2016–2024).

pmc-13493378.creator: Jianing Liu, Zhuorui Jiang, Chenglin Zhou, Wenzi Wang
